summary: The ChangePasswordNoMaster feature is a password change page for users, built in ASP.NET Web Forms, enforcing strong password rules, user responsibility agreement, and handling workflow for all primary user types (Student, Instructor, Staff Admin, DC, Supervisor) with appropriate redirects and error messaging.
purpose: Allow authenticated users to change their password securely, ensuring compliance with security and privacy policies, and confirming explicit user agreement to organizational policies.

fields.name: txtCurrentPassword
fields.description: Current password entry by the user.

fields.name: txtNewPassword
fields.description: New password entry by the user.

fields.name: txtNewPassword2
fields.description: Repeat new password entry for confirmation.

fields.name: chkPolicy
fields.description: Checkbox for user to confirm agreement with policies.

actors: User (generic/account holder: Student, Instructor, Staff Admin, DC, Supervisor)

workflows.name: Change Password
steps: Page loads client scripts and initializes UI labels and messages (labels for current, new, and confirmation password; policy text).
User enters Current Password, New Password, and New Password confirmation fields.
User checks the policy agreement box.
Client-side and server-side validation of all fields is performed.

Password is validated for: required, min 12 chars, contains letters and digits, contains upper and lower case, contains symbol, not equal to current password, new password matches repeat entry, policy agreement checked.
If validation passes: call Security.ChangePassword with user session, current password, and new password.
If password change is successful: Show success message and redirect user based on role-type (Student, Instructor, Staff Admin, DC, Supervisor); otherwise, redirect to Tools.
If validation or change fails: show errors and stay on page.
User may cancel at any time, which triggers redirect based on role-type or Tools.

business_rules: New password must not be the same as current password.
User must agree to policies before changing password.
On success, user is redirected according to their role.
validations: New password must have at least 12 characters.
New password must contain a combination of letters and digits.
New password must include both uppercase and lowercase letters.
New password must include at least one symbol.
New password must be different from the current password.
calculations: PasswordStrength indicator calculates strength (weak, average, good) based on entered new password, requiring at least 12 characters, 1 number, 1 symbol, uppercase and lowercase.
conditions: If all validations pass and password change is successful, show success and redirect.
If any validation fails, show errors.
If user cancels, redirect based on user's role.
system_behavior: Initializes page labels, policy text, and sets focus to current password.
Handles error and warning panels for user feedback.
Manages redirect logic for different user roles.
dependencies: UserSession for authentication and role management.
Security class for password validation and change.
Resources for localization of UI messages.
HelpRecord/Text for displaying up-to-date policy text.
ASP.NET Validators for client/server field checks.
exceptions: If password change fails (invalid, policy not met), show appropriate error messages.
If role information for redirect cannot be determined, default to Tools.aspx.
content_gaps: Exact regex patterns for password requirements are referenced from Resources but not shown.
Textual content for user responsibilities/policy is dynamic and referenced from the database, not included here.
